goal: Add a quantitative visual resolution atlas and a rigorously developed coupled feedback family to the existing release.

coupled_family.domain: q,r,a,b are real and strictly between 0 and 1
coupled_family.primary_target: Unique normalized entire functions with positive odd coefficients, both of order rho, where spr([[q^rho,r^rho],[a^rho,b^rho]])=1.
secondary_targets: finite positive lower and upper type if a complete proof is found
precisely scoped obstruction to constant linear decoupling of the functional differential system
nonclaims: historical novelty without a bounded primary-source comparison
sharp leading asymptotic constants without proof
all parameter regimes outside the contraction domain

resolution_atlas.target: Explicit worked bounds relating observation radius, precision, or detecting polynomial degree to a structural difference.
resolution_atlas.requirement: Distinguish analytic or exact certificates from high-precision illustrations and from universal lower bounds on all possible detectors.

completion: Current proof status is independently audited; runnable examples and computed figures are included; the integrated PDF and source archive are saved. If a proposed theorem fails, preserve the counterexample or exact gap and revise the exposition honestly.
